_help: 2026-08-03 END-TO-END VALIDATION of the merged HF file (output/evaluation_set_with_kg_aware) BEFORE uploading to HuggingFace. Scores the 3 KG-aware model keys (kg-aware/gpt-5.1/{oracle,kg_rag_32,oracle_kg_rag}) DIRECTLY off the consolidated per-instance eval-set in ONE pass (each hash_id appears once -> no per-op tree needed, unlike score_kg_prompt.py). The 3 keys carry model_type='kg-prompt' (routed by preloader.process_kg_prompt_predictions) and every triple carries an `operation` stamped from its per-op point dir, so the per-TKGU-op C/G-R/E-R come out and should REPRODUCE the published ladder output/kg_prompts_scored/20260727_native_3500/ladder_table.csv. edc-plus-open-ai/gpt-5.1 is included as the no-KG reference (its EDC+ numbers should still match Table 3). Metrics are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the Table-3 reproduction (20260725_kg_prompt_ladder): C=completeness_score/all-mpnet(>0.9), G-R=gj-recall/bert-base, E-R=cie-recall/exact_match. load_results_from_cache is FALSE so this run actually scores; use a FRESH output/cache pkl path (fresh-score-dir discipline). GPU only — NOT a cluster login node. input_dataset_path / output_path / cache_path are set on the CLI.
_snapshots_note: NULLED on purpose: KG snapshots are ONLY needed to classify relik-cie predictions (exists vs add) via snapshot membership. models_to_report has NO relik-cie, and kg-prompt's E-R comes from direct QID exact-match (no snapshot lookup) — so loading the 7 snapshots (~180G RAM) is pure waste here. Nulling skips the load (loader treats fname=None as an empty snapshot) WITHOUT changing any reported number. Re-populate only if you ever add relik-cie to models_to_report.
